lucan_hub: ^A young man sits on the steps below the throne with his sword laid on the step beside him, as if he'd put it down to free a hand. He's handsome even now, in a coat cut for a coronation and torn at the shoulder. There's a bundle of letters on his knee, their seals broken.
^"Lucan Varro. On the commissions I signed Lucanus, the Seventh Voice. I chose it the winter I opened the box. It looked very well in red wax."

b: ^. I'm sorry. A week ago I'd have sung them up again for you, and you'd have hated me for it."

lucan_hub: ^"The histories will say the Seventh Voice was beaten on his own steps. I'd like it put down that I sat."
lucan_letters: ^"The Kindler's. They were on my own table in the study, under the plans for the procession. I never opened one. He wrote such long letters, and I had a capital to take."
^"He calls me friend in every one. He calls everyone friend, I gather. I took it as a particular honour."
^"He thanks me for the rooms, and for an escort as far as my gate. The crate went north with him. He hopes the coronation goes well. The wax on these is red, too. It was always his wax."
lucan_stopped: ^"You'd broken my breath twice. The third time I heard what I was singing. I was calling my own guard up off this floor to die for me again. One of them taught me to ride."
^"A chronicle would call that the turning of the tide. It was a man on a floor, out of breath, who'd stopped liking his own voice."
lucan_box: ^"It came down to us from the Lady Livia's household, with the silver and the debts. Every Varro before me dusted it and left it shut. I was the first with an education."
^"On the inside of the lid, in her hand, it says never open it. You only read that afterwards."
^"Four years learning what was in it. I had the voice for it. Everyone always said I had the voice."
^"There's one ship off the Mole I never called up. I had the verse for her. I found I hadn't the right."
lucan_refuse: ^"To Tollhaven, to be tolled at the gate and tried on the quay? The League's Speaker would be within her rights."
^"But he's days ahead of you, and he means to light something with what he's carrying. I know the road, and he'll be expecting me. Let me go first."
lucan_north: ^"North. Up to the Heights, after him. He's taken it where the fire was lit the first time, and when he gets there he'll want a Voice. He hasn't asked me. He's never asked. He assumes."
^"I'd like to tell him no in person. It's the one thing I've learned this spring that wasn't in the box."
lucan_go: ^He stands, and puts the letters inside his coat. He looks at the sword on the step for a while and leaves it there.
^"I wanted the empire, not its kitchen fire. It seems they were the same room."
^"My mother called me Luke. It never looked like much in wax."

b: ^ Hester Quaile will want to hear which way he went.

lucan_go: ^He walks down the hall of banners and out through the courtyard, without hurrying. Behind him the dead in the hall stay where they fell.
